## Purpose

- Product/domain:

## Risk gates

- [ ] No PHI/secrets/credentials committed
- [ ] Clinical impact assessed
- [ ] Billing/coding impact assessed
- [ ] Identity/RBAC impact assessed
- [ ] Data migration impact assessed
- [ ] Backward compatibility assessed

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Smoke test
- [ ] Acceptance criteria verified
- [ ] Rollback procedure documented

## Consequential-action review

If this changes clinical decision support, EHR write-back, prescribing, coding/billing, credentialing, legal workflows, or patient communications, identify the required human approval gate and evidence.

## Architecture / documentation

List ADRs, interface contracts, runbooks, diagrams, and Notion source-of-truth pages updated by this change.
